Commentary.Commentary: Done with this one-sided game. Our focus now shifts to Afghanistan vs Bangladesh encounter on Thursday which promises to be an exciting one. Both teams defeated Sri Lanka quite easily and will be high on confidence. Don't miss this Group B fixture starting at 1530 local (1130 GMT) in Abu Dhabi. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Says that it is always important to pick wickets to win any game. Praises Kedar Jadhav for bowling well in the absence of Hardik Pandya. On the line and length, Bhuvi states that on flat tracks like these, where the ball does not swing, the bowlers do not have any option than to stick to lines and lengths. Admits that the conditions are very difficult for players and hence the reason for Hardik getting injured.

Victorious Indian captain Rohit Sharma says that India were very disciplined right from the start, learning from the mistakes in the previous game. Praises his bowling unit for doing exceedingly well in extreme conditions. Stresses further that the spinners kept it tight in the middle overs after the seamers picked up wickets at the start. Feels that it was important to take the wickets of the Pakistan openers as the team has been relying heavily on them and the seamers' immaculate stump-to-stump line made it difficult for the batting side. Also says that during the Malik-Babar stand, he told his team that there is no need to panic as one wicket would change things and that's exactly what happened. On Kedar Jadhav, Rohit says that the all-rounder has taken his bowling quite seriously and played a terrific role, especially with Hardik Pandya injured. On his own batting, the skipper smiles and says that he is happy to get amongst the runs and states that it is always important that the openers set the tone. Praises the middle order for finishing the job as well.

Pakistan skipper Sarfraz Ahmed says that their start was poor and after a partnership between Azam and Malik they again lost wickets in clumps. Admits that it was a bad outing for them with the bat with plenty of soft dismissals, barring Babar Azam. Smiles and says that they prepared for the Indian spinners but ended up giving their wickets away to the other bowlers. Considers it as a wake-up call for his team and expects to bounce back in the next match.

Earlier in the day, Pakistan elected to bat but lost their in-form openers very cheaply. Shoaib Malik and Babar Azam steadied the innings with an 82-run stand but post that they experienced a collapse. Kedar Jadhav and Bhuvneshwar Kumar picked up three wickets apiece and never allowed their rivals to get back on their feet. All in all, they managed to outclass Pakistan in all the facets of the game.

Defending a below par total, Pakistan needed their star fast bowlers to pick some quick wickets with the new ball but that didn't happen. After that their bowling looked quite ordinary and the injury to Shadab Khan didn't help their cause much. Ambati Rayudu and Dinesh Karthik spent quality time in the middle to hand India a comprehensive win.

A walk in the park for India! So much build-up was given to this game but it failed to live up to the expectations. It was a flop show from the Pakistan batting as they managed a paltry total on the board and after that they never stood a chance to be honest. The Indian openers provided a flying start and that in itself nearly sealed the deal. Rohit Sharma, in particular, looked in scintillating form and notched up a fifty. Shikhar Dhawan also stroked a valiant 46 to back up his century yesterday, thereby showing that he has truly returned to form after a dismal English tour.

FOUR! INDIA WIN BY 8 WICKETS WITH 126 BALLS REMAINING! Shoaib Malik serves a long hop on middle, Rayudu goes back and pulls it thunderously through square leg for a boundary. All done, an easy win for the Men in Blue.
Floated ball on middle, Karthik nudges it through square leg for a run.

FOUR! Connects and connects well. Flighted on middle and leg, Karthik goes down on one knee and sweeps it with the turn to the fine leg fence. Malik showing special affinity to the leg stump line here. India a boundary away now.
A full toss on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Flighted and on middle, swept straight to short fine leg.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
A mishit! Once again Rayudu comes down the track and lofts it over covers. Not timed quite well but a run taken.
Goes on the back foot and punches it straight to the cover fielder.

Dropped by Sarfraz? Flatter and around off, Rayudu steps forward and across to defend but seems to get an inside edge (going by the bowler's reaction) onto the pads. It lobs in the air, Sarfraz moves forward quickly but fails to grab the ball.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Rayudu pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Swift footwork shown by Rayudu. He speeds down to the pitch of the delivery and lifts it easily over mid off for a boundary. 10 needed more.
Dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Full and once again down the leg side, swept behind square leg for one. 9 from the over.
Shortish and pulled through square leg for a run.

FOUR! Malik fires a full ball down the leg side again, Karthik kneels and nails his sweep shot wide of short fine leg for a boundary. It has come after a gap of 34 balls, the longest period for India in this chase.
A juicy full toss again by Malik. Down the leg side and Rayudu sweeps it through backward square leg. It beats the diving fielder stationed there and they cross for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, Karthik turns it towards square leg and takes a single.
A low full toss on the pads, Rayudu tickles it through backward square leg for a run.
Shoaib Malik is into the attack now.
Lunges to a full ball and pushes it to the off side, straight to the cover fielder.
Short this time outside off, DK goes back and cuts it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Another delivery fired in around off, Karthik defends it from the crease to the off side.
Full and around off, once again pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
Slower full ball around off, Karthik gets on the front foot and defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter on off, Rayudu advances down the track and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Very full and on middle, DK keeps it out safely once again towards mid-wicket.
Hits the yorker mark around off, Karthik digs it out from the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Amir lets out a grunt and bowls a length ball on off, Rayudu stays back and at the last minute runs it down to third man for a run.
Digs in a short ball around off, angling away, Rayudu leans back and lets it through to the keeper.
Too full in length on middle, Rayudu whips it across the line but finds the mid on fielder. That was a forceful hit by AR.

A length ball angling away from the batsman, Rayudu plays it down with soft hands to covers and scampers across for a single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Rayudu was safely in by then.
Fakhar drops it short on middle and DK pulls it with ease to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Again Ambati uses his feet to reach the pitch of the delivery and drives it through covers for one.
Steps down the track to a full ball and plays it back towards the bowler.
Loopy full ball on off, Karthik drives it off his front foot to long off for a single.
Slower this time, full and around off, it goes straight on after landing as Karthik pushes inside the line and misses. Not too far that from the off pole.
Full and flighted on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Sharp delivery around leg and angling down, Rayudu is beaten for pace as he fails to flick. He is hit on the pads, Amir lets out an appeal but to no avail.

A loose and lazy shot. Amir delivers it full and outside off, probably a slower one, Karthik is early into the drive and hence fails to control his shot. Ends up chipping it in the air but is lucky that it goes over the infield on the off side. A single taken as the sweeper cover fielder cuts it off in the deep.

Bowls a length ball in line of the stumps, Rayudu moves back to make some space and then taps it down towards covers. He sprints down the track in search of a run but Karthik sends him back. Ambati returns as the fielder misses his shy at the keeper's end. No one backing up the throw and now they cross for an overthrow.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length around middle and leg, Rayudu gets behind the line and defends it back.
Good length delivery angling away from the batsman from around off, Rayudu defends it from the back foot.
Mohammad Amir is back into the attack.
Slightly quicker this time, full and outside off, DK plays an open-faced drive but finds the short third man fielder.
Strides forward to a full ball and drives it with the spin to long off for a run.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and blocks it.
Full and on middle, Rayudu presses forward and pushes it down to mid on.
Rayudu has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air, full and landing on middle, Rayudu pushes it off his front foot to mid off. 'Ye achcha hai', says Sarfraz from behind the stumps. It's rare to hear him praising his bowlers.
On a length outside off, quietly played down to third man for one. 8 from the over, 34 more needed.

FOUR! Well played! An innocuous delivery, short and outside off, Rayudu shuffles a bit and steers it past the left side of the backward point fielder. It speeds away and third man has no chance of stopping it.

Shortish and around off, Rayudu plays it down towards covers and steps out. Karthik responds and comes running down but only to be sent back. He returns as the fielder misses his shy at the non-striker's end. The mid on fielder does well to back up that throw by putting his body on the line.
A touch short in length outside off, Karthik opens the face of the bat and dabs it down to third man for another single in this over.
A length ball angling down the leg side, Rayudu moves across the stumps a bit and helps it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single. Doing it with ease, India.
Good length ball on off, Karthik plays it late and guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball on off, DK defends it by pressing forward.
Use of the feet by Rayudu and he caresses it down through mid off for a run.
This time Karthik rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
Short and outside off, cut off the back foot but straight to the point fielder this time.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it firmly towards the cover fielder.
Now Rayudu tries to tap a length ball on the off side and run but Karthik sends him back. 45 more needed and it seems only a formality is left in this match now.
Well done. Full and around off, angling in, Karthik taps it down on the off side and steals a single.
A cracking cover drive by Karthik this time. He finds the middle of the bat but fails to beat the fielder inside the ring.

Full and angling into the batsman, Rayudu tries flicking this time but closes the face of the bat early. It pops out from the leading edge and goes aerially but in the gap at cover-point. A single taken.
Bouncer and around off, Rayudu drops his wrists and allows it through to the keeper. Called a wide for height.
Lands it on a length around off, Rayudu defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Good length delivery outside off, Karthik plays it down from the crease to third man for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another delivery skidding  back in from around middle, DK tries defending but it takes the inner half of the bat and rolls behind to fine leg. A single taken.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! A slider landing around middle, skidding down, Karthik fails to put bat on ball and is hit on the pads. Missing leg.
Karthik has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

SIX! That has gone all the way! Zaman drops it short and on middle, Karthik goes deep inside the crease and launches it over mid-wicket for a biggie. A bit strange from Sarfraz to continue with a part-timer when we all can sense that this game won't last more than 35 overs. Maybe, he is now looking to rest his main bowlers.
Too full and around leg, forced down to long on for a run.
On a good length and closer to the off stump line, Rayudu pushes it with an angled bat wide of backward point. The fielder moves across to his right to stop the ball and the batsmen cross for a run.
A little bit of width on offer outside off, Karthik taps it down to third man for a single. Gets off the mark.
Full and angling into the batsman, Karthik plays it off his pads to mid on.
Dinesh Karthik is the new batsman.

OUT! A soft dismissal, have to say. Ashraf is very lucky to get a wicket by bowling a boundary ball. Short and wide outside off, slower in pace, Dhawan rocks back to slap it square of the wicket on the off side but fails to keep it down. Babar Azam at backward point makes no mistake. A smiling Dhawan returns. Although India are in a cruise control.
Bowls it on a length and outside off, Dhawan goes hard at it as he tries to force it through covers. Fails to find any timing and bottom edges it near the surface.
FOUR! Wrong line to start this spell by Ashraf. He bowls a full ball on the leg stump line. Dhawan picks it off his pads and neatly deflects it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl.
Fullish and around leg, Dhawan sweeps it behind square leg and brings up India's 100 with a single. 63 more needed now.
Another drive off the front foot by Rayudu and this time he manages to find the gap through covers. A single taken.
Tossed up ball on off, driven off the front foot to covers.

What happened there? Shadab Khan is feeling some discomfort after delivering the last ball. Maybe, issues with his hip muscles. Sarfraz has a chat with him and the leggie is now seen going off the field. Not a good sight for Pakistan. Earlier in the day, Hardik Pandya left the field on a stretcher. Wishing a speedy recovery to both the players. Fakhar Zaman, in the meantime, will complete the over.
Probably a top spinner this time. It skids in from around off, Rayudu draws forward to push through the line but it takes the inside half of the bat and rolls to mid-wicket.
Very full on this occasion, outside off, it's driven through the line but straight to covers.
Tossed up ball on off, an attempted leg spinner, Rayudu is forward in defense.
Ali switches to over the wicket for the right-hander and delivers a short ball. Rayudu stands tall to pull it to fine leg for a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery on off, a back foot punch this time by Dhawan. It rolls through in front of square this time and travels to the deep cover region. A single taken.

FOUR! No stopping this one. It's hit well and hit in the gap. Shortish length ball outside off, Dhawan stays back and whacks it square of the wicket on the off side. It beats the point fielder and races through. The third fielder sprints across to his left to cut it off but fails.
Another delivery angling into the batsman from outside off, Dhawan stays back to push it out on the off side.
Hasan steams in from around the wicket and angles in a good length delivery on off, Dhawan defends it off his back foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, Dhawan leans forward and forces it through mid on for one. End of a successful over for Pakistan but they need wickets in a cluster.
Khan shortens his length and bowls it outside off, Dhawan cuts but finds the point fielder. Shadab gets away with a bad one.

FOUR! A very lazy fielding inside the ring and Sarfraz's face says it all. Floated delivery by Shadab, too full and outside off, Dhawan drills it through the line and the cover fielder lets it through. No protection in the deep and it's a boundary.
Turning back into the batsman from around off, a bit on the shorter side which allows Dhawan to go back and defend.
Flighted full ball on off, it's driven down through mid off for a single. Rayudu is off the mark first ball.

Drinks break. Pakistan will be relieved to see Rohit's back but he has already done the damage. Their bowlers now will have to force a collapse from him to make a match out of it. Ambati Rayudu has joined Dhawan in the attack now.

OUT! Through the gate! Shadab comes into the attack and produces the desired result for Pakistan immediately. A leg spinner landing on the leg stump. Rohit is forward to play at it, probably with the spin, but it goes straight on, beats his bat, brushes his back pad a bit and then lights the bails. The Green team is delighted but a wicket too late one would say. 77 needed more off 221 balls.
Shadab time.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! What a fine way to get to your half century. A half century outside off, Rohit leans and chips it over cover for a boundary. His 35th ODI Fifty.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.

SIX! BOSH! I am reminded of my student days when my teacher used to tell me, 'Son, if you don't learn, you will get punished.' Seems like India are telling that to Pakistan at the moment. The short stuff is being hammered with disdain but the bowling side still continues to bowl. Pulled over mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
FOUR! What a shot. Full on middle, Dhawan whips it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off for a run.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. One run added to the total.
Nothing on the Free Hit. Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
FREE HIT TIME...

ANOTHER NO BALL. Faheem walks back with a furious look on his face to have a check on where his foot landed. Reminds me of the recently completed Asian games where athletes used to check where their foot landed after making a long jump attempt. Sarfraz has his mouth covered by his gloves - not quite sure whether he is muttering something or not. The fans cannot bear to watch. Oh Pakistan, so Pakistan with the bat. But they have simply not turned up with the ball. Regarding that delivery, it was on  a length, outside off, pushed towards point.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, steered to third man for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Around off, watchfully defended.

SIX! Up, up and away! A short ball, Pakistan seem to be defiant to learn. Keep on peppering the Indian batsmen and keep pulled over the ropes. This one's gone over deep square leg. There is a man in the deep but he has no chance. Just 98 needed now.
Outside off, pushed towards cover for a quick single.
Full and around middle, pushed towards cover. Powerplay 1 done and dusted and India are going along smoothly.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Shikhar misses his flick.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! GLORIOUS! If Babar's dive was brilliant, Dhawan's drive is ultra-brilliant. A length ball outside off, Dhawan creams this through point and this time no one is stopping that.
Excellent fielding! Babar Azam the hero. Full and outside off, Dhawan drives it through the covers and seems to thread the gap but Babar dives to his right and stops the ball. Brilliant.
A bit slower, outside off, angling away, Dhawan looks to guide it towards third man but misses.
Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Double change. Faheem Ashraf to bowl from the other end.
Full on leg, chipped uppishly towards mid on. The ball nearly went all the way to the fielder. Dhawan initially wanted a single but then sent Rohit back.
Taps it behind point and scampers through for a quick single.

FOUR! Easy peasy. The length is short, the line is outside leg, the body reaction is the swivel, the stance is head high, the ball direction behind square leg and the final destination - boundary. 50 UP FOR INDIA!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and leg, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, played towards point.
Hasan Ali now.
Outside off, played towards point. 19 from that over. But a look at Usman's figures - 4-0-27-0 - one will realize that it has been one bad over that has spoilt his spell.

SIX! Rubbish bowling. Forget where the fine leg is, Usman is not correcting his length at all. Short, six. Short, four. Short, now six. Rohit swivels and pulls it massively over mid-wicket. That nearly hit the roof.
FREE HIT TIME!

NO BALL, FOUR! First, a mistake. Then a crime. Again, with fine leg up, Usman drops it short. Once more, he is pulled away, this time with authority, behind square leg. Then, the umpire raises his right hand sideways to indicate more misery to Usman, Sarfraz and Pakistan.

TOP EDGE, SIX! Fine leg was inside the circle and Usman, for some reason, dug it in short. Rohit did not need a second invitation. He instinctively went for the hook but the quickness on the ball did him in. However, the pace also helped him as the ball travelled over the fine leg fence in a flash. 128 more to win.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This is outside off, steered towards third man for a run. 'I think it is time Sarfraz starts to look at other options', quips Aamer Sohail on air.
On middle and leg, flicked towards deep square leg for a single.
Waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it pretty late, almost through the vacant slip cordon to third man for a run. 10 from the over.

FOUR! After the power, comes the placement. Amir overcompensates for the short ball bowled previously and delivers an overpitched one. Rohit leans and exhibits a delightful cover drive. Treat to watch. 137 more to win.

FOUR! BOOM! Fractionally short outside off, Rohit lashes out the cut and gets it behind point. Third man starts to run, continues to run but eventually cannot even get close to the ball. Rohit moves to 10 with his second boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

THE CROWD COMES TO LIFE. This is what they want to see. Banter. Amir bows this on a length outside off and Rohit calmly defends. The bowler finishes his followthrough, then walks a few steps and chides Rohit. The response from the Indian skipper is first a smile, then perhaps an indication that you do your job, I shall do mine. Amir walks back like an obedient fellow and then smiles while looking at the umpire. The crowd cheers both players. They want more...

Risky run. Dhawan works it towards mid on and calls for a quick single. The fielder comes charging in but then slips while diving and his throw bounces awkwardly past the stumps at the non-striker's end. Now had he not slipped, Dhawan could have been in trouble.

A bit of a delay. Shikhar Dhawan is not happy with the disturbance behind the sightscreen. The members are taking their own sweet time to get their dinner or snacks to their seat and are not even sitting down. Busy chatting with the others around, till they are politely informed that the game has been stalled. All ready now.
Another length ball, a bit of extra bounce, punched towards cover.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a run.
A short ball, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
A bit edgy. A length ball, Rohit looks to force it through the off side but ends up slicing it uppishly, behind point towards third man. A single taken.
Similar line and length, pushed towards mid off.
On a length around off, watchfully defended towards point.
Very full, almost a yorker outside off, well dug out. Pakistan's first MAIDEN.
Good line and length, just around off, tightly defended.
Full and outside off, the southpaw comes forward and drives it with the full face of the bat towards cover.
This one nips back a long way, SD looks to work it to the leg side but misses and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. Amir screams his lungs out for an LBW appeal but well...
That one bounced from nowhere, pitched on a length, Shikhar looked to defend but then got squared up because of the ball shooting. Somehow managed to fend it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Dhawan pushes and starts to run but Rohit sends him back on seeing the cover fielder charge in.
Outside off, Dhawan waits and steers it to third man for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
A length outside off, SD slashes hard but misses.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Ooohhh... bizarre. Normally one gets an edge when the ball does something. Nothing much of that here. The ball comes in and somehow Dhawan misses his flick. A leading edge is induced which does not carry to cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, a play and a miss.

Poor fielding, excellent running. Dhawan works this wide of mid on and Shoaib Malik, one of Pakistan's best fielders, gives it a chase. However, he prefers not to put in a dive and allows the ball to go through. He chases it all the way to the boundary and the batsmen take that opportunity to come back for the third. 149 more needed.

FOUR! GORGEOUS! No swing and the fuller length comes as a sweet dish for Indian batsmen. After the rough tour of England, this will come as a nice feeling. Full and outside off, Dhawan leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
On a length outside off, coming in a touch, Dhawan lets it go.

Good ball, lovely shot, excellent fielding. Full and outside off, swinging in, RS watches it closely, plays it late, pushes it back down the ground and starts running. But then mid off comes across quickly and puts in a full length dive to his right to stop the ball. Rohit has to go back. Good cricket all around.

The bowler is lucky on this occasion. Usman angles this away from the right-hander but the ball is way too far from the batsman. Almost goes out of the pitch after swinging but umpire Erasmus gives the benefit of doubt to the bowler.
Similar ball, pretty wide, Sharma chases but misses.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.

INSIDE EDGE, FOUR! Usman has his hands on his head. Nearly got the Indian captain there. The ball is on a length, outside off, Rohit looks to push it through the off side but the ball moves while his feet don't. Inside edge, past the stumps, to the fine leg fence. 156 more needed from 292 balls.
Outside off, Dhawan waits for the ball to come to him and guides it to third man for a single.
Usman Khan to bowl with the second new ball.
Leaving the right-hander on  a fuller length, Rohit taps it with an open bat face towards point. Good start from Amir, only 2 from the first over.
Amir drags his length back a touch as Sharma taps it towards cover-point. Wants a run but he has been rightly sent back by his partner.
Fuller in length, in line of the stumps, Rohit leans ahead and defends it with a high elbow.
Full ball down the leg side, Shikhar whips it away to fine leg for a run and gets off the mark.
On a length outside off, holding its line. Dhawan points his bat skywards to allow it through.

India and Rohit are underway! On a length on middle and leg, Sharma tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes off. Has to change his direction as he senses that he might collide into Amir on his followthrough. Completes the run safely in the end.
Out come the Indian openers. Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma are the openers. Mohammad Amir to start off proceedings. The skipper to face. Here we go!!!

The Pakistan team gets into a huddle. They don't seem overly disappointed but then their captain always looks grumpy, even while winning. It will be interesting to see how he manages his temper if things don't go Pakistan's way in the field.

The players are back in the field. 163 to chase. How many overs will it last? 30? 35? Can Pakistan make a match out of this? Don't bother about attempting your occult powers. The reality will descend soon.
